verdict_detail: System is architecturally sound and functionally complete for core fitness features. Ready for controlled beta launch (100-1000 users) on Android. NOT ready for unrestricted production launch until critical security issue (AI API key exposure) is resolved.

passed.detail: tsc --noEmit EXIT 0. strict: true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true.
GitHub Actions: typecheck + lint (ratchet 804) + prettier + vitest. Concurrency management.
AES-256-GCM v3 for health data, AI conversations, notes, alerts. SecureStore for keys.
Biometric + PBKDF2-hardened passcode. Rate limiting. Lockout. Emergency wipe.
PremiumGate active. AccessState machine. 24h offline grace. Clock tamper detection. 5 telemetry events.
Schema v20 with 20 migration versions. Integrity validation. Self-healing repair. WriteFirewall. WAL durability.
15 languages. Exercise translation pipeline (3,312 exercises × 14 languages). LRU cache for runtime resolution.
Root ErrorBoundary + ScreenErrorBoundary per screen. SystemGuard state machine.
Sensitive keys auto-redacted (token, secret, password, key, session, biometric, receipt).
SovereignExportService for full data export. PostHog opt-out. Privacy policy + terms of service screens.
Encrypted local backups. Optional cloud backup. Snapshot recovery service.

conditional_pass.detail: Dual AI (Coach + Professor) works but API keys are exposed in client bundle. Must proxy through backend before production AI launch.
conditional_pass.action_required: Remove EXPO_PUBLIC_ AI keys from production config OR disable AI features for launch

conditional_pass.detail: HealthKit (iOS) adapter exists. Health Connect (Android) adapter exists but crashes — feature flag disabled.
conditional_pass.action_required: Debug Health Connect crashes, enable behind feature flag for beta

conditional_pass.detail: expo-notifications configured in plugins but no scheduling logic implemented.
conditional_pass.action_required: Implement local notifications for streak reminders and trial countdown

conditional_pass.detail: 48% estimated coverage. 25+ services untested. Zero screen-level tests.
conditional_pass.action_required: Reach 65%+ service coverage before scaling beyond 1000 users

failed.detail: EXPO_PUBLIC_GROK_API_KEY, EXPO_PUBLIC_GROQ_API_KEY, EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENROUTER_API_KEY are client-extractable. This is a billing exposure.
failed.action_required: MUST resolve before any public release with AI features enabled

internal_alpha.notes: All core features functional. Can test with team immediately.

closed_beta_100_users.notes: Acceptable risk level. Monitor Sentry for crashes. Disable AI features or accept limited key exposure with usage monitoring.

blockers: AI API keys must not be in production bundle
Push notifications needed for trial conversion
open_beta_1000_users.notes: Without AI key proxy, billing exposure scales linearly with users.

ios.detail: Podfile exists, iOS config in app.config.ts, but no evidence of iOS builds or testing in project.
blockers: App Store submission requires Apple Developer account + review
ios.risk: HIGH — iOS may have platform-specific bugs not caught by Android-only development

web.detail: react-native-web configured. Web preview works for UI iteration.
blockers: Many native modules (expo-sqlite, biometrics, health) don't work on web

crash_reporting.detail: DSN configured, 20% trace sampling, release tracking, screenshot on error

analytics.detail: Event tracking, session replay (native), GDPR opt-out

subscription_monitoring.detail: Revenue, churn, MRR, subscriber count via RevenueCat dashboard

alerting.detail: No alerting rules in Sentry or PostHog. No PagerDuty/Slack integration.
alerting.recommendation: Set up Sentry alert rules for crash rate spikes and new error types
